eva_missions.title: Jezero Crater: Western River Delta Marswalk
eva_missions.objective: Reach the hydrated carbonate margin, sampling delta strata on the way, and return on suit consumables.
eva_missions.usgs_geologic_unit: Hesperian-Noachian lacustrine and deltaic fan deposits

waypoints.name: Habitat / Octavia E. Butler Base
waypoints.science_task: Baseline suit telemetry and MEDA atmospheric check.

waypoints.name: Airfield Sigma (Ingenuity scout zone)
waypoints.science_task: Inspect the Ingenuity rotorcraft (NSSDCA 2020-052A) for dust and UV degradation.

waypoints.name: Kodiak Butte delta scarp
waypoints.safety_status: CAUTION (steep scarp, keep 30 m cliff buffer)
waypoints.science_task: Image ancient river cross-bedding strata and sample mudstone.

waypoints.name: Hydrated carbonate margin
waypoints.safety_status: SAFE-MODERATE (use rover assist for core return)
waypoints.science_task: Drill shoreline carbonate outcrops for ancient biosignatures.

eva_missions.title: Gale Crater: Mount Sharp Boxwork Traverse (Curiosity benchmark)
eva_missions.objective: Walk from the ridge base to the boxwork vein zone and sample ancient groundwater minerals.
eva_missions.coordinate_warning: These waypoints (lat -5.41 to -5.43) lie about 18 km south of the supplied Gale extent (lat -5.11 to -4.07). Confirm which coordinates are correct.
eva_missions.usgs_geologic_unit: Aeolis Mons sulfate-bearing and boxwork ridge unit

environmental_status.alert: YELLOW: moderate wind gusts near ridge

waypoints.name: Gediz Vallis ridge base
waypoints.science_task: Calibrate spectrometer against ancient debris-flow boulders.

waypoints.name: Mount Sharp boxwork formation zone
waypoints.safety_status: CAUTION (sharp mineral ridges, watch suit boots)
waypoints.science_task: Sample boxwork mineral veins formed by ancient groundwater.
